verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists a code editor alongside the drag-and-drop editor, and the CLI is described as giving scripts "full access" to workspaces, so template content can plausibly be edited as HTML and scripted. Nothing in the pack shows a templates API, MJML support, variable substitution, or a version-control workflow; transactional and broadcast APIs only trigger messages set up in the UI. missing for 10: documented template CRUD API, MJML support, variable/Liquid substitution docs, git/version-control workflow, independent hands-on corroboration.
